gaps.description: No single repo artifact defines the controlled organism activation contract across chips, runtime, UI, persistence, registry and rollback.
gaps.evidence: Many shadow/dev harnesses and chip packages exist, but no observed productive activation contract.

gaps.description: Observed authority surfaces are distributed across UI, API, Supabase clients, MBA service role services, registries and chip docs.
Supabase persistence is present, but RLS, table policies, indexes and tenant isolation were not verified from database state.
gaps.evidence: supabase/prisma/db/migrations folders were not observed in this platform root.
gaps.required_next_evidence: DB schema, RLS policy and service-role write audit.

gaps.description: MBA and parallel production persistence can use service role keys.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Explicit service role allowlist, denylist, audit log and rollback design.

gaps.description: Shadow services and dev harnesses are present, but the allowed promotion path from shadow candidate to productive authority is not observed.
gaps.evidence: EVE00-EVE08 shadow/dev routes exist; packages remain candidate/dev-only unless separately wired.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Promotion gate contract and human approval checkpoints.

gaps.description: Registry and runtimeAuthority concepts exist, but a unified registry write policy for organism activation is not observed.
gaps.evidence: rector-docs registry declares runtimeAuthority for documents; shadow harness tests reject registryWrite true.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Registry authority table and write path audit.

gaps.description: No canonical event bus/outbox contract was observed for organism-level activation.
gaps.evidence: MBA event ledger and runtime observation routes exist, but no organism-wide outbox contract found in inventory.

gaps.description: No explicit kill switch, rollback ledger or activation disable path was observed.
gaps.evidence: Feature flags exist for intake and env configuration; no organism-level kill switch observed.

gaps.description: Productive UI has active flows and dev routes coexist, but the approved UI entrypoints for chip activation are not defined.
gaps.evidence: src/app/page.tsx, admin routes and dev routes coexist.

gaps.description: Session owner boundaries exist, but end-to-end tenant isolation for every write route is not proven in this inventory.
gaps.evidence: session-boundary.ts exists; many API routes must be reviewed route-by-route.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Route-by-route tenant and session ownership matrix.

gaps.description: There are many regression tests, but no single activation precheck test suite was observed for the whole organism.
gaps.evidence: 120 test files observed; tests are chip/feature/regression-specific.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Activation precheck suite covering authority, persistence, registry, UI and rollback.

gaps.description: Worktree has EVE04 deleted/modified/untracked state; activation work must not use dirty candidate state without isolation.
gaps.evidence: git status showed deleted EVE04 candidate files and modified EVE04 shadow service/test.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Clean or explicitly isolated EVE04 bundle state.

gaps.description: Manual visual approvals exist for dev harnesses, but these are not productive authority.
gaps.evidence: EVE01/EVE02/EVE03/EVE08 UI trace/manual visual approval closeouts exist or were requested previously.
gaps.required_next_evidence: Explicit distinction between visual QA and production activation.

gaps.description: OpenAI coach services and env vars exist; organism activation must define whether LLM calls are allowed, shadowed or disabled.
gaps.evidence: OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL used by operational-description-coach services.
gaps.required_next_evidence: LLM boundary contract and audit logging.
